about.description: What this file holds, in a sentence or two, with a link to the docs.

id.description: Permanent id, used as an anchor and in links from other files.

checked_on.description: The day the entry was compared with its public source.

name.description: The name as the maker writes it.

group.description: shared: several makers' products write or read it. app-formats: one app's own format that a named second product also writes or reads. hardware-codecs: codecs and camera interfaces. steward-projects: made by stewards of this repository, listed apart so they are not mistaken for established standards.

kind.description: protocol: two programs speak it over a network or link. format: a file, URL or message shape. settings: a setup link or settings file one app imports. data: a dataset. codec: a way to compress video or audio. interface: a cable or bus that carries a camera's picture.

openness.description: open: a public spec, or open-licensed code whose docs describe it. documented-closed: the maker describes it publicly, but the spec is partial or the product closed. undocumented: no written description; public code, if any, is the only reference. not-public: not published yet.

licence.description: A short licence line. Null when codec or transport facts carry the licensing.

maker.description: Who makes or maintains it. The credit belongs to them, not to this list.

url.description: The page that best describes it, the maker's own where one exists. Null only when not public.

description.description: One line written for this list. Left out when word is set.

word.description: The words.json id of the same thing, when it is also a glossary word. Equal to this entry's id; the glossary explanation is used instead of a description.

service_ids.description: Catalogued products that write or read it, as service ids.

other_users.description: Named products that write or read it but are not in services.json.

label.description: What the page is, in a few words.

sources.description: Public sources for the claims. Empty only when not public.

notes.description: Anything else worth knowing, or null.

value.description: How it may be used, as its licensors describe it: royalty-free patent licences, patent pools, an open spec, open-source code without a separate spec, or a proprietary SDK. Not legal advice.
